title: Notifications
help: Who gets each notification, and when the phone rings. Pilotix’s sounds do not change.
unsavedHere: Not saved yet: press « Save » at the top.
hoursText: {{hours}} · the sound cannot be turned off
soundsText: One fixed sound for each notification

desc.order: An order arrives and goes to an agent.
desc.callback: It is time to call a customer back.
desc.returned: The customer refused: the parcel comes back.
desc.taken: An order goes to another agent.
desc.alert: A parcel is on alert or its delivery failed.
desc.depot: The new orders to prepare, grouped: once every 15 minutes at most, during working hours.
desc.message: The customer writes on WhatsApp, Messenger or Instagram.
desc.info: Evening report, waiting queue, pay, couriers…

infoText: These notifications come from Pilotix’s other pages: Pilot Automations, pay, couriers, the depot’s red alerts… They are turned on, and who gets them is chosen, in their own page.

roleDesc.agent: The one who confirmed the order
roleDesc.agent_order: The one who has to call
roleDesc.agent_callback: The one who has to call back
roleDesc.agent_taken: The one who loses the order
roleDesc.suivi: The one who follows the parcel
roleDesc.suivi_message: Once the order is on the road

blockHint: The agent’s blocked screen is set in Confirmation (« Block until the call »).
blockHintHere: The agent’s blocked screen is set in « Calls » (« Block until the call »).
depotNote: The depot’s red alerts (an order changed or cancelled at the depot) are set in Depot › Settings.
sameRing: The same ring as « Callback » and the blocked screen. It does not change.
sameRingCb: The same ring as « New order ». It does not change.
fixed: A Pilotix sound: it does not change.

phoneHint.work: The phone rings during working hours. After that, the notification waits in the bell.
phoneHint.always: The phone rings at any hour.
phoneHint.never: Never on the phone: only in the bell, when Pilotix is open.

callback.t: 📞 Samira has to call Amina back

taken.b: Not handled in time: given to Rania

message.b: PX1234 · Hello, does the stroller come in grey? · for Samira
